name: monday.com
description: monday.com's hosted server reads and changes boards, items, columns and updates, so the agent can file work and report on it where the team already tracks it.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (auth.monday.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
